Two do not: test_a_leaked_implement_line_in_check_tests_stops_tests_fix_withheld requires exit 3, and test_a_record_effort_mismatch_at_tests_fix_stops_with_class_model requires a stop. The conclusion survives — the six are exactly six, confirmed by a full-suite run — but the finding carries no quotation pair as docs/concerns.md:17-19 requires (no fixture line, no contract words), and its reproduce is the whole three-suite command, which at the ref returns three failures, none of them the six, because the implementation it depends on was never committed. envelope.note: Six of six UPHELD. Grounded by reproduction, not reading: the implementer's work was never committed, so the tree carries no implementation. Three probe modules under out/scratch override _LadderFixture._stage_tool_bytes (test_ladder_lever.py:818) to stage ladder.py with one added clause in validate_check_tests — `or (verdict == "changes" and not findings)` appended to the disjunction at ladder.py:799-805 — without touching the snapshot; git status is clean at the ref before and after. Run 1 (probe_full_suite.py): 85 tests, 8 failures — the six named plus the two symlink tests already red at the ref, so the implementer's list is exact, complete with no extras. Run 2 (probe_patched_ladder.py): 19 tests, the six fail, each with `stopped stage=check-tests ... reason=envelope`. Run 3 (probe_repaired_plants.py): same driver, plus the one-line plant repair (stage_findings={"check-tests": [dict(CHECK_TESTS_FINDING)]} wherever a fixture plants a bare check-tests changes verdict) — 19 tests, OK. The implementation and the fixtures are not in conflict; the fixtures are, and no charge is lost by repairing them. Grounding words: jobs.json:72 "verdict is changes when any finding exists and approve otherwise"; class docstring at test_ladder_lever.py:3372; ladder-lever.md:39 naming the driver-written findings file as tests-fix's input; docs/concerns.md:17-19. Mechanism: the stub builds findings at test_ladder_lever.py:422 from stage_findings alone, so a bare verdict emits findings=[] with zero counts. grep finds ten check-tests changes plants — the six bare ones at 2111/2302/2373/2468/2479/2895 and four in the new class that plant findings explicitly. Verdict changes: the tests-fix must repair the six plants and should also pin the envelope-vs-withheld precedence. Biggest miss, above the adjudicated question: the implement run's whole work product is unrecoverable — write_path.py is absent from the tree and from context/diff.patch, both task suites are still red on it, and the implementer filed that as p3.
